policy.verified_statuses_require: current direct data or controlled current-game observation

game_versions.label: Historical client CSV versions pending longitudinal inventory

sources.title: Four local custom/private-server APK static inventories

mechanics.current_hastycr: Client Speed converted as tiles/minute to integer millitiles/second; buffs and charge multiply it.
mechanics.conclusion: Current field and conversion are source-backed, but live trajectory calibration is absent.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Instant direction change with integer step; obstacle steering chooses and persists a perpendicular side.
mechanics.conclusion: Implementation-defined and likely trajectory-sensitive.
mechanics.needed_experiment: MOVE-002 obstacle corner approach from mirrored offsets

mechanics.current_hastycr: All non-flying units use bridge terrain; JumpEnabled does not grant unrestricted river traversal.
mechanics.conclusion: Code choice is explicit but live jump boundary/timing is unresolved.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Candidate edge gap must be within source sight range; fallback building/tower may be outside sight as destination.
mechanics.conclusion: Field is current-data-backed; edge-distance semantics are not observed.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Target acquisition subtracts target collision radius; attack reach adds target collision radius but not attacker radius.
mechanics.conclusion: Fundamental shared geometry is unresolved and simulators use differing conventions.
mechanics.needed_experiment: TARGET-001 plus ATTACK-001 center/edge distance isolation

mechanics.current_hastycr: Valid current target is retained between periodic scans; some units clear it after attack via RetargetAfterAttack.
mechanics.conclusion: Sticky behavior exists but timing and RetargetAfterAttack semantics are inferred.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Periodic full scan staggered by UID; current constant is implementation-defined.
mechanics.conclusion: High-frequency shared timing has no direct evidence.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Strictly smaller edge gap wins; exact ties retain first entity insertion order.
mechanics.conclusion: Insertion-order tie behavior is deterministic but may be externally meaningless or exploitable.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Required ground gap is sum of source-backed collision radii.
mechanics.conclusion: Radius fields are source-backed; visible contact semantics and attack geometry remain unresolved.
mechanics.needed_experiment: COLLISION-001 two-unit contact with ground-point annotation

mechanics.current_hastycr: Pair displacement is inverse-mass weighted.
mechanics.conclusion: Mass values exist in data; exact displacement model is a simulator interpretation.
mechanics.needed_experiment: COLLISION-002 heavy/light contact from controlled positions

mechanics.current_hastycr: Overlap correction multiplies overlap by a fixed strength and distributes by mass.
mechanics.conclusion: Correction model and strength are not current-data-backed.
mechanics.needed_experiment: COLLISION-003 clump relaxation over high-FPS frames

mechanics.current_hastycr: A fixed number of pairwise passes followed by a final building push-out.
mechanics.conclusion: Numerical solver choice is implementation-defined.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Insertion-ordered pair iteration; collisions occur after attack/movement in the active-unit stage.
mechanics.conclusion: Potential insertion-order sensitivity and cross-engine disagreement need direct tests.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Attack reach is source range plus target collision radius.
mechanics.conclusion: Range value is data-backed; effective geometry is not observed.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Load time starts on target change and counts down after entering attack range.
mechanics.conclusion: Value is data-backed; start/cancel/restart semantics need observation.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Damage/projectile launch occurs when the windup timer reaches zero on the fixed 50ms tick.
mechanics.conclusion: Tick quantization and same-tick release order are unresolved.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Hit speed is loaded after a completed cycle; timer decrements before release test.
mechanics.conclusion: Current values are data-backed; phase alignment is not measured.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Target change resets windup; range loss stops attack but preserves timers according to current state fields.
mechanics.conclusion: Cancellation and backswing semantics are incomplete as an explicit state machine.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Generic flight distance is computed from attacker/target positions with no calibrated visual muzzle offset.
mechanics.conclusion: Unknown shared launch geometry.
mechanics.needed_experiment: PROJECTILE-001 launch contact-point and impact annotation

mechanics.current_hastycr: Source projectile speed determines integer flight time from launch gap.
mechanics.conclusion: Value is source-backed; visual trajectory/quantization parity is unmeasured.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Area/splash radii are source fields evaluated at impact.
mechanics.conclusion: Data-backed radius does not settle center/contact or swept-boundary semantics.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Homing shots follow target identity; non-homing shots retain launch geometry.
mechanics.conclusion: Flag is source-backed; target-loss and moving-target parity need observation.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Generic projectiles resolve scheduled impacts; rolling spells use separate movement/hit logic.
mechanics.conclusion: No unified swept-collision model is established.
mechanics.needed_experiment: PROJECTILE-004 crossing target at high relative speed

mechanics.current_hastycr: Only explicit source-declared reflection/deflection subsets intercept tracked projectiles.
mechanics.conclusion: Special-case coverage is partial and shared interception semantics unresolved.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Deploy remaining time gates active targeting/movement/attack.
mechanics.conclusion: Source delays exist; first-active phase and visual spawn timing need measurement.
mechanics.needed_experiment: SPAWN-001 deploy frame to first movement/attack

mechanics.current_hastycr: Members of a deployment group are added sequentially in one action; no generic temporal stagger is modeled.
mechanics.conclusion: Potentially important swarm timing is unknown.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Summon count/radius are source-backed; members are evenly distributed around a circle.
mechanics.conclusion: Radius is data-backed but angular ordering/orientation is an implementation interpretation.

mechanics.current_hastycr: Ground movement uses a static flow field over modeled river/bridge terrain.
mechanics.conclusion: Arena coordinates and bridge geometry lack controlled current observation.
mechanics.needed_experiment: ARENA-001 both-seat landmarks and bridge edges

mechanics.current_hastycr: Static terrain flow field plus local dynamic-building perpendicular steering.
mechanics.conclusion: Dynamic obstacle routing is implementation-defined and cross-engine architectures differ.
mechanics.needed_experiment: PATH-001 controlled obstacle offsets and trajectories

mechanics.current_hastycr: Building-only units consider visible buildings by target edge gap; otherwise nearest building is fallback destination.
mechanics.conclusion: No measured pull map; this remains a primary RL uncertainty.
mechanics.needed_experiment: PULL-001 Hog/Giant/Balloon versus Cannon tile sweep

mechanics.current_hastycr: Scheduled effects/projectiles/statuses precede deploy activation; then target, attack/move, separation, spawners, and cleanup in explicit code order.
mechanics.conclusion: Implementations materially disagree and no live result selects an order.

parameters.name: river traversal eligibility
parameters.value: flying only bypasses bridge flow field

parameters.name: distance convention
parameters.value: center distance minus target radius for sight; plus target radius for reach

parameters.name: attack range
parameters.value: per-character source field plus target radius

parameters.name: formation pattern
parameters.value: even angular distribution over source radius

parameters.name: system sequence
parameters.value: scheduled effects -> target -> attack/move -> separation -> spawners -> cleanup

evidence.claim: HastyCR loads a current Speed field and uses an explicit integer conversion.
Current code uses instantaneous normalized stepping and persistent perpendicular obstacle steering.
Current candidate filtering, edge-gap distance, periodic scan, fallback, stickiness, and tie procedure are directly observed in code.
Current pairwise mass-weighted overlap correction and building push-out are directly observed in code.
Current range, windup, cooldown, release, and retarget procedures are directly observed in code.
Current scheduled generic flight, homing, rolling-spell, area, and reflection subsets are directly observed in code.
Current deployment activation, group insertion, and formation procedures are directly observed in code.
Current static flow-field and local dynamic obstacle behavior are directly observed in code.
Battle.step provides an explicit HastyCR same-tick procedure.
Independent implementations use differing center/edge adjusted distance conventions; executable boundary comparison is pending.
Staged targeting and sticky-target concepts exist independently, but exact tie rules have not been reproduced.
Independent engines include pair collision and mass/push concepts but differ in staging and correction procedure.
CRForge attacks before physics while CR Rudy moves/collides before combat; Python engines interleave per entity.
External engines stage projectiles differently; no current live observation selects a procedure.
Independent engines use A-star, arena flow/routing, or local obstacle helpers; behavior has not been normalized/executed.
Synthetic scenarios prove deterministic plumbing only and cannot establish live mechanics.
